title.narrative: Strong CSOs for human rights accountability in Bokeo province, Lao PDR

description.narrative: The overall objective is to improve the respect and fulfilment of human rights among ethnic minority communities in Bokeo Province of Lao PDR, by supporting the functionality of accountability processes. In particular, the Actions specific objective is to develop the capacity of CAMKID and CBOs (Community Based organisations) to promote social accountability of local authorities and other duty-bearers for respect of human rights of vulnerable ethnic communities in Houaxay and Phaoudom districts, of Bokeo province.

title.narrative: CAMKID and/or GLIU receive an average of 5 requests per month for legal information from volunteers or WPCs by end of project

description.narrative: CAMKID and/or GLIU receive an average of 5 requests per month for legal information from volunteers or WPCs by end of project

comment.narrative: An average of 5 requests per month

Unable to quantify number of requests for information due to challenges in data collection.GLIU members from two target districts report having helped to negotiate improved working conditions in 10 of 14 banana plantations located near 10 of the projects target villages since the start of the project. Information exchange happens during regular monitoring visits.As at the end of Year 3 they are not regularly receiving 5 requests per month for legal information as per indicator text but also are not keeping records of each time a legal request is made. The number of requests for legal information was initially high but has dropped as issues have been resolved and working conditions have improved.

comment.narrative: 2 requests per month

Unable to quantify number of requests for information at the moment due to challenges with data collection.At the end of Year 3 a survey of 11 WPCs confirmed having provided legal information to community members requesting it but there are no records to quantify this. title.narrative: Increase of 30% over baseline of workers requiring health services for themselves or their families utilised local health services by end of project

description.narrative: Increase of 30% over baseline of workers requiring health services for themselves or their families utilised local health services by end of project

comment.narrative: According to the baseline 808 of camp workers are able to access healthcare facilities outside of the camp. Baseline survey didnt ask about the utilisation of services in a right way. This value is about access not utilisation. This question will be reworked during the midterm review.

According to the baseline 808 of camp workers are able to access healthcare facilities outside of the camp. Baseline survey didnt ask about the utilisation of services in a right way. The baseline value is about access not utilisation so the original target was correct. According to MTR survey 83 stated having access to health facilities which is considered as satisfactory level. At MTR the utilisation was reported to be 53. Thus there is a need to revise the endline target to be 60.

MTR survey 83 stated having access to health facilities which is considered as satisfactory level. This figure was 80.8 at baseline. The baseline survey didnt measure the actual utilisation of health services by camp workers. At MTR the utilisation was reported to be 53.There is a need to revise endline target for the utilisation. Our proposal for the target is 60.
